The polarization in the two Bands is consistent with each other, presenting multiple polarization morphologies.
The most striking is that the polarized emission generally follows along the spiral structures
This is the first time that the spiral structures have been resolved in Band 4.
This polarization alignment with the dust continuum spiral structure in L1448 IRS3B has not been shown before.
On the size scale of the inner envelope surrounding the circum-multiple disk, the polarization is consistent with magnetic field dust grain alignment.
On the very small scale of compact circumstellar regions, we see polarization that is consistent with scattering around source $a$ and $c$, which are likely the most optically thick components.

Finally, we see polarization that is consistent with mechanical alignment of dust grains along the spiral dust structures, which would suggest that the dust is tracing the relative gas flow along the spiral arms.
In other words, we do not see strong evidence of radiative dust alignment in L1448 IRS3B.

In order to explore the polarization of disks, we use the young multiple protostellar system L1448 IRS3, as circumbinary disks to date are among the few sources with posited combinations of magnetic field and scattering polarization mechanisms.
